column1: # 0.69d0 modules the scope fits are made of (make_pack.py, prepare_donor.sh): the optics whose meshes
# make_pack.py finds in our variants (each a variant's translation: scopes_lib.Modules.match), and
# the rails and mounts 0.69d0 puts under an optic on the new guns (mounts.tsv), placed as 0.69d0
# places them. Rails: their material as 0.26g gets it: loc2:<name> an existing material of ours
# (weapons/loc2/<name>), else 0.69d0's made again on the 0.26g template named (retexture.py).
# A base: a module only its locators are taken of (our gun has it in its own mesh).
# A sight: an iron sight module, up (its `model`, as the gun's port baked it in) and folded (its
# `model_param1`, as 0.69d0 shows it under an optic): sights.tsv folds the one into the other.
